reason: Base UI draws Checkbox and Radio as a span, so shadcn's disabled:opacity-50 (a :disabled selector) never matches and a disabled control stays fully opaque upstream; foundation reads [data-disabled] instead, which is what the utility means. registry/ui fix, not a vega value.

The preset is generated with rtl:false, so its paddings and radii are physical (pl-/pr-, rounded-l-) and do not mirror under dir=rtl; the layer-3 rules are logical. The section proves DirectionProvider renders, not a value.

registry/ui's FieldDescription keeps nth-last-2:-mt-1 but not [[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5, which shadcn carries beside it; the utility layer beats the layer-3 legend rule, so -4px wins over -6px. registry/ui difference, not a vega value.

registry/ui's InputGroupButton passes `size` to Button (documented in tooling/preset/README.md); shadcn's does not, so upstream the button keeps Button's default size (h-9, gap-2, size-4 icons) under the input-group size classes. registry/ui difference, not a vega value.

A preset app's globals.css carries no .cn-* rules, so the cn-input-otp class the shadcn component keeps is unstyled there; style-vega.css's `.cn-input-otp { gap-2 }` is the preset's value and vega keeps it.

The shortcuts contain ⌘, which is in neither Inter build: the reference app falls back through next/font's Inter Fallback and the preview through Inter Variable plus the Pretendard Hangul fallback, so the glyph advance differs by 0.5px. Font stack, not a value.

registry/ui's ContextMenuSubContent carries `cn-context-menu-subcontent`; the upstream name is `cn-context-menu-sub-content`, so vega's shadow-lg rule never matches the element. registry/ui typo, not a vega value.

registry/ui's QuestionnaireActions dropped shadcn's `sm:min-h-9`, so the action row stays at min-h-11 (44px) where upstream shrinks to 36px; a utility, so no layer-3 rule can reach it. registry/ui difference, not a vega value.

Dark mode only: Tailwind sorts the preset's dark: colours (dark:bg-input/30, dark:border-input, dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50) after the state utilities that have no dark counterpart (aria-expanded:bg-muted, focus-visible:border-ring, aria-invalid:aria-checked:border-primary, .cn-sidebar-input's bg-background), so upstream an open trigger, a focused outline button, an invalid checked checkbox and the sidebar search box lose their state colour in dark. vega keeps the state colours; reproducing the ordering would delete the signal.
